depth.description: Peak bicep curl contraction angle at the top of the curl

torso_lean.description: Momentum swinging or arching back during curl lift

coaching_tips.shallow_depth: Incomplete contraction. Squeeze your biceps at the top until forearms approach your shoulders.
coaching_tips.excessive_lean: Stop swinging your torso! Pin your elbows to your sides and lift with pure bicep tension.
coaching_tips.good_rep: Excellent curl form! Zero body sway with full range of motion.
